rule: The Wales buyer map. Welsh NHS organisations are taken from the NHS Organisation Data Service register every run and filtered on the register's own country field, never on 'has no ICB link'. An organisation whose ODS record carries a legal end date is excluded, because ODS leaves merged and dissolved bodies at status Active. The procurement route is read at NWSSP's own site and every field carries the URL and the date it was read. Buyer-name spellings and their counts are read from the Find a Tender and Contracts Finder notices already captured in data/company-awards.json; nothing is inferred from a name that does not appear in a notice. NWSSP has no ODS record of its own, so it appears as the procurement route rather than as an organisation.

noIcbs: Wales has no Integrated Care Boards. The seven Local Health Boards are both the commissioner and the provider for their area, which is why every Welsh row in data/trust-map.json carries a null icb and why an England-shaped stakeholder map does not describe Wales.

procurementRoute.name: NHS Wales Shared Services Partnership — Procurement Services
procurementRoute.whatItIs: The single procurement service for NHS Wales. It runs the frameworks and the tenders that the seven Local Health Boards and three NHS Trusts buy through, rather than each of them tendering separately.
procurementRoute.whatItIsSourceQuote: As an established Procurement Service we have been assisting the Health Boards and Trusts in the delivery of patient centred services for NHS Wales Shared Services.
procurementRoute.buysOnBehalfOf: The health boards and trusts across NHS Wales.
procurementRoute.buysOnBehalfOfSourceQuote: Information about how to register for contract opportunities and details about the types of goods and services procured by NHS Wales Shares Services Partnership on behalf of health boards and trusts across NHS Wales can be found below.

advertisedOn.name: Sell2Wales
advertisedOn.sourceQuote: Frameworks are advertised on Sell2Wales ( www.sell2wales.gov.uk ) where suppliers are given the opportunity to bid for business.

procurementRoute.frameworkScope: Both goods and services, including capital equipment, pharmaceutical, medical and clinical, food and textiles, utilities, maintenance, information technology and the commissioning of healthcare services.
procurementRoute.frameworkScopeSourceQuote: NWSSP Frameworks covers both goods and services including, capital equipment, Pharmaceutical, medical and clinical, food and textiles, utilities, maintenance, Information technology and the commissioning of healthcare services.
procurementRoute.frameworkTermSourceQuote: Frameworks or contracts generally last for three to four years.
procurementRoute.smes: Tenders are broken into smaller lots where appropriate so that small and medium enterprises can bid.
procurementRoute.smesSourceQuote: NWSSP welcome tenders from small and medium enterprises where appropriate tenders are broken down into smaller lots to make it easier for SME's to bid for business.
